newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA, MALAYSIA SIGN INVESTOR PROTECTION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA, MALAYSIA SIGN INVESTOR PROTECTION DEAL.

text.p: Botswana and Malaysia have signed an agreement aimed at expanding economic and industrial co-operation, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said on Friday.
The agreement provides assurances against expropriation and nationalisation and for investors to freely repatriate profits.

Both countries have agreed to respect the dispute procedures of the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID), arbitration by the International Chamber of Commerce or an ad hoc tribunal established under the arbitration rules of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL).
There is currently little trade and no investment between the two countries.

Malaysian prime minister Mahathir Mohamad recently led a Malaysian business delegation to Botswana when he was the guest of honour at a Southern African Development Community 'Smart Partnership' conference in April.
